# New Look Interiors

> > Prince George's premier kitchen and bathroom renovation contractor specializing in custom cabinets, countertops, flooring, and full-service remodeling.

New Look Interiors, owned by Jody Tindill and Dave Eddy, serves Prince George and Northern BC with award-winning kitchen and bath renovation services. The company offers a comprehensive 6-step remodeling process, featuring products from trusted brands like Moen, Silestone, Caesarstone, and Cambria, along with custom and RTA cabinet solutions.

## Key Topics

- Kitchen renovation and remodeling
- Bathroom renovation and design
- Custom cabinet design and installation
- RTA (ready-to-assemble) cabinets
- Quartz countertops (Silestone, Caesarstone, Cambria)
- Flooring solutions (hardwood, vinyl, laminate, tile)
- Prince George and Northern BC service area
- Jody Tindill and Dave Eddy ownership
- Plumbing fixtures (Moen, Maax, Pearl)
- Custom closet organization
- BC building code compliance
- 6-step renovation process
- Cabinet hardware and accessories
- Renovation planning and budgeting
- Home safety and asbestos abatement
